prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1366; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover, trunk lid edge, and right taillamp assembly show crush and cracking consistent with a rear-end impact, and the repair plan addresses each panel with replacement and refinishing as needed. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this damage. No prior damage to the vehicle is known to me. I cannot say with certainty that every area noted came from this single impact, so I recommend a follow-up look at the lower quarter panel mounting points before final approval. The invoices reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operation.
